metadata.name: squads_clear_signing
metadata.description: Clear-signing companion program for Squads Protocol v4 proposal approvals

instructions.name: verify_proposal
docs: Verify that the Squads v4 vault transaction stored on-chain matches
`args.instructions` exactly, and that this transaction contains the
matching Squads vote instruction (and nothing else). Aborts otherwise.

accounts.name: proposal
docs: The Squads v4 `Proposal` being voted on (the sibling vote's proposal).
validated in the handler; the vote must target this exact account.

accounts.name: transaction
docs: The Squads v4 `VaultTransaction` the proposal belongs to.
the handler against the proposal.

instructions.name: verify_buffer_hash
docs: Verify that a BPF upgradeable-loader Buffer account's program bytes
hash to `args.expected_hash` (SHA-256 via the native `sol_sha256`
syscall over the bytes with trailing zeros trimmed — byte-identical to
`solana-verify get-buffer-hash`).
Bundle it before `verify_proposal` + the Squads vote when the proposal
under approval is a program upgrade, so the offline signer sees the
exact build being deployed, not just the buffer's address. Aborts the
transaction on any mismatch.

accounts.name: buffer
docs: The BPF upgradeable-loader Buffer account whose contents are checked.

instructions.name: assert_account_hash
docs: Assert that an arbitrary account's raw data hashes to
`args.expected_hash` (SHA-256 over the **untrimmed** account data, as
lowercase hex), and — when `args.owner` is `Some` — that the account is
owned by that program. Lets an offline signer pin the exact state of
any account a proposal depends on (a config, a mint, an oracle, ...)
**at vote time**. Only data and (optionally) owner are covered — not
lamports or the executable flag; a non-existent account has empty data
and the system program as owner. Aborts the transaction on any mismatch.

accounts.name: account
docs: The account whose data (and optionally owner) is asserted.

instructions.name: assert_program_revision
docs: Assert that a deployed loader-v3 program runs exactly the build hashing
to `args.expected_hash`. A specialization of `assert_account_hash` for
upgradeable programs, which keep their code in a separate ProgramData
account:
1. the `program` account equals `args.program`, is owned by the BPF
upgradeable loader, and is in the `Program` state;
2. the `programdata_address` stored in it equals the passed
`program_data` account, which is also loader-owned and in the
`ProgramData` state;
3. the ProgramData's program bytes (trailing zeros trimmed) SHA-256 to
`args.expected_hash` — byte-identical to
`solana-verify get-program-hash <program>`.
The ProgramData metadata (deploy slot, upgrade authority) is not part
of the hash, so the digest identifies the build, not the deployment.
Like every assertion here it holds at vote time only: a program with
a live upgrade authority can change before the proposal executes.

accounts.name: program
docs: The loader-v3 Program account (the program id).

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The ProgramData account the program account points at.
`ProgramData` state, and program-bytes hash are validated in the handler.

instructions.name: verify_proposal_cpi
docs: `verify_proposal` for a **programmatic signer**: a member key that is a
PDA and can only sign inside a CPI. Must itself be invoked via CPI,
with the member signing.
The content checks are identical to `verify_proposal`. The difference
is where the Squads vote is looked for: not among the top-level
instructions, but in the instruction list that the signer program (the
"driver") executes, parsed from the top-level instruction this CPI
descends from. Two drivers are recognised:
- the **ed25519 programmatic signer**: the top-level instruction is its
`Submit`, and the list is the execution message handed to the
message executor;
- **Vector**: the top-level instruction is a `Passthrough` of the
Vector program, signing as the member (a vector account or its
system PDA). No other instruction of that program may appear in the
transaction except `Advance`.
In both, the member must not be a transaction signer, and this
instruction must be one the driver invokes directly.
The list is located by parsing the driver's framing, not from an
argument. It must contain this very invocation and otherwise consist
only of this program's instructions and the expected vote.

accounts.name: proposal
docs: The Squads v4 `Proposal` being voted on.

accounts.name: transaction
docs: The Squads v4 `VaultTransaction` the proposal belongs to.

accounts.name: member
docs: The multisig member casting the vote: the programmatic signer, which
must sign this CPI (and equal `args.member`). For Vector, this is a
vector account or its system PDA.

types.name: ExpectedAccountMeta
docs: Expected account meta of an inner instruction.

types.name: ExpectedInstruction
docs: One expected instruction inside the vault transaction, fully expanded
(indexes resolved to pubkeys) so an offline device can render it.

fields.name: program_id
docs: Program the instruction invokes.

fields.name: accounts
docs: Ordered account metas, exactly as compiled into the vault transaction.

fields.name: data
docs: Raw instruction data, byte-for-byte.

types.name: ProposalAction
docs: The kind of Squads v4 vote instruction expected next to `verify_proposal`.

types.name: VerifyBufferHashArgs
docs: Binds a buffer account to the exact build the offline signer reviewed.

fields.name: buffer
docs: The buffer account under verification (must equal the passed account —
duplicated here so the offline device renders it from the args alone).

fields.name: expected_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the buffer's program bytes with trailing zeros trimmed, as a
**lowercase hex string** (64 chars) — byte-identical to what
`solana-verify get-buffer-hash` prints, shown as-is to the signer so it
can be compared against a locally reproduced build.

types.name: VerifyProposalArgs
docs: Everything the offline signer needs to see, in one IDL-decodable blob.

fields.name: multisig
docs: The Squads v4 multisig this proposal belongs to.

fields.name: transaction_index
docs: Index of the vault transaction / proposal being voted on.

fields.name: vault_index
docs: Vault (authority) index the transaction executes under.

fields.name: num_ephemeral_signers
docs: Number of ephemeral signer PDAs the transaction uses (usually 0).

fields.name: member
docs: The multisig member casting the vote — must be the signer of the
sibling Squads vote instruction (i.e. the offline device's own key).

fields.name: action
docs: Which vote the sibling Squads instruction must be.

fields.name: instructions
docs: The complete, expanded instruction list of the vault transaction.
Must match the on-chain `VaultTransaction` exactly.

types.name: AssertAccountHashArgs
docs: Binds an arbitrary account to the exact state the offline signer reviewed.

fields.name: account
docs: The account under verification (must equal the passed account —
duplicated here so the offline device renders it from the args alone).

fields.name: owner
docs: If set, the program that must own the account.

fields.name: expected_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the account's raw data (no trimming), as a **lowercase hex
string** (64 chars).

types.name: AssertProgramRevisionArgs
docs: Binds a deployed upgradeable program to the exact build the offline
signer reviewed.

fields.name: program
docs: The program id under verification (must equal the passed account).

fields.name: expected_hash
docs: SHA-256 of the ProgramData's program bytes with trailing zeros
trimmed, as a **lowercase hex string** (64 chars) — byte-identical to
`solana-verify get-program-hash <program>`.
